caption: Eqi Glacier, Ilulissat

description: Eqi Glacier is a wide wall of white and blue ice meeting the sea, seen from the water at a distance, with a little brash in front and dark rock at the sides. The local night is clear, about -5.2°C, with wind near 17.8 km/h and moonlight on the face. Local time is 22:30 America/Nuuk. There is no boat and no lit lodge. This is the calving front, not the iceberg-filled icefjord.
